using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ProjectBuilding;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.ProjectBuilding.Tests;

public class AbpIoSourceCodeStoreTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly ServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<AbpIoSourceCodeStore>> _loggerMock;

    public AbpIoSourceCodeStoreTests()
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddLogging();
        services.AddAbp(typeof(ISourceCodeStore), options =>
        {
            options.Services.AddSingletonMock<ILogger<AbpIoSourceCodeStore>>();
        });
        
        _loggerMock = services.GetSingletonMock<ILogger<AbpIoSourceCodeStore>>();
        _serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _serviceProvider?.Dispose();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_LogInformation_When_Using_Local_TemplateSource()
    {
        // Arrange
        var store = _serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<AbpIoSourceCodeStore>();
        var templateSource = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "local-template");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(templateSource);
        
        try
        {
            var expectedMessage = "Using local template: test-name, version: 1.0.0";
            var zipPath = Path.Combine(templateSource, "test-name-1.0.0.zip");
            await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(zipPath, new byte[0]);

            // Act
            await store.GetAsync("test-name", SourceCodeTypes.Template, "1.0.0", templateSource);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.LogInformation(expectedMessage),
                Times.Once());
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(templateSource))
            {
                Directory.Delete(templateSource, true);
            }
        }
    }
}
